pages.title: VB-G RAM G Bill, 2025 to replace MGNREGA

facts.text: Bill: Viksit Bharat–Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin) Bill — VB-G RAM G — to replace MGNREGA (2005)
facts.head: News

facts.text: Called: largest structural change in 20 years
facts.head: News

facts.text: Feature: Guaranteed days; MGNREGA: 100 (up to 150 in special cases); VB-G RAM G: 125 (Section 5(1))
facts.head: MGNREGA vs VB-G RAM G

facts.text: Feature: Wage funding; MGNREGA: Centre 100%; VB-G RAM G: 60:40; 90:10 for NE and Himalayan states
facts.head: MGNREGA vs VB-G RAM G

facts.text: Feature: Allocation; MGNREGA: Bottom-up labour budget from Gram Panchayat; VB-G RAM G: Normative — set by Centre
facts.head: MGNREGA vs VB-G RAM G

facts.text: Feature: Agriculture pause; MGNREGA: None; VB-G RAM G: 60 days in peak sowing/harvest
facts.head: MGNREGA vs VB-G RAM G

facts.text: Feature: Cards; MGNREGA: Job cards valid 5 years; VB-G RAM G: Gramin Rozgar Guarantee Cards valid 3 years
facts.head: MGNREGA vs VB-G RAM G

facts.text: Feature: Penalty (Section 27); MGNREGA: ₹1,000; VB-G RAM G: ₹10,000
facts.head: MGNREGA vs VB-G RAM G

facts.text: Cost: central ₹95,692 crore; total ₹1.51 lakh crore; extra burden on states about ₹30,000 crore/year
facts.head: MGNREGA vs VB-G RAM G

facts.text: Average MGNREGA employment: about 50 days per household
facts.head: MGNREGA vs VB-G RAM G

facts.text: Planning: Viksit Gram Panchayat Plans — water security, core rural infrastructure, livelihood infrastructure, extreme weather mitigation; integrated with PM Gati Shakti
facts.head: MGNREGA vs VB-G RAM G

facts.text: Special cards: single women, PwDs, elderly, released bonded labourers, PVTGs, transgender persons
facts.head: MGNREGA vs VB-G RAM G

facts.text: Nominal rural wages (2015–25): grew only 3.6–6.4% a year (Labour Bureau)
facts.head: Data

facts.text: MGNREGA eligibility: adult members of any rural household
facts.head: Data

facts.text: Launched: NAP-AMR 2.0 for 2025–29; earlier NAP-AMR 1.0 in 2017
facts.head: News

facts.text: Approach: One Health — human, animal and environmental health interlinked
facts.head: News

facts.text: Governance: inter-sectoral supervision under NITI Aayog via a Coordination & Monitoring Committee; States urged to set up State AMR Cells; national dashboard proposed
facts.head: News

facts.text: ⚠ Weakness: no binding Centre–State mechanism; AMR levers are mostly State subjects
facts.head: News

facts.text: NAP 1.0 State plans: only Kerala, MP, Delhi, AP, Gujarat, Sikkim, Punjab
facts.head: News

facts.text: OOPE: 39.4% of Total Health Expenditure
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: World Bank: AMR may cut 3.8% of global GDP by 2050
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: Watch-group antibiotics: about 59% of consumption (2022); about 8 in 10 hospital entrants carry drug-resistant bacteria
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: Animal antibiotics: India 4th largest consumer; use to rise about 82% by 2030
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: Musi River (Hyderabad): antibiotic levels about 1,000× safe limits
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: FDC ban: 156 irrational FDCs banned in 2024
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: Newborns: 50,000+ deaths/year from resistant sepsis; India has the highest MDR-TB burden
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: Term: NDM-1; Meaning: New Delhi Metallo-β-lactamase — resistance to β-lactams incl. carbapenems
facts.head: Terms and measures

facts.text: Term: Schedule H1; Meaning: Drugs & Cosmetics Rules — select antibiotics only on prescription, register kept
facts.head: Terms and measures

facts.text: Term: Red Line Campaign; Meaning: Red vertical line on antibiotic strips
facts.head: Terms and measures

facts.text: Term: Delhi Declaration on AMR; Meaning: 2017 inter-ministerial commitment
facts.head: Terms and measures

facts.text: Term: Chennai Declaration; Meaning: Medical societies' consensus on rational antibiotic use
facts.head: Terms and measures

facts.text: Term: ICMR-AMRSN; Meaning: AMR surveillance network, 2013
facts.head: Terms and measures

facts.text: Term: Kerala; Meaning: PROUD and AMRITH initiatives
facts.head: Terms and measures

facts.text: Ban: colistin in animal feed
facts.head: Terms and measures

facts.text: Resistance mechanisms: limiting uptake, target modification, efflux pumps, drug inactivation (β-lactamases)
facts.head: Terms and measures

pages.title: ULLAS literacy scheme and Bihar's non-participation

facts.text: Goal: 100% literacy by 2030 (NEP 2020, SDG-4)
facts.head: News

facts.text: Issue: Bihar refuses to join ULLAS; runs own Akshar Anchal scheme (15 years; Dalits, Mahadalits, minorities, EBCs, women 15–45)
facts.head: News

facts.text: Full form: Understanding Lifelong Learning for All in Society; launched 2022 by Union Education Ministry
facts.head: ULLAS

facts.text: Target: non-literates aged 15+; literacy up to Class 3 level; test → certification
facts.head: ULLAS

facts.text: Benchmark (August 2024): 95% literacy = 100% "fully literate"
facts.head: ULLAS

facts.text: Literacy definition 2024: reading, writing, numeracy + digital, financial literacy, life skills
facts.head: ULLAS

facts.text: Fully literate declared: Himachal Pradesh, Mizoram, Goa, Tripura, Ladakh
facts.head: ULLAS

facts.text: ⚠ Andhra Pradesh lowest literacy — 72.6%; Bihar 2nd lowest — 74.3% (male 82.3%, female 66.1%)
facts.head: Data (PLFS 2023–24)

facts.text: Bihar non-literates (15–59): about 2 crore, incl. 1.32 crore women; Census 2011 literacy 61.8% (lowest then)
facts.head: Data (PLFS 2023–24)

facts.text: Bihar funds 2023–24: ₹35 crore (Centre ₹21 crore, State ₹14 crore) — zero utilisation; 7% interest penalty
facts.head: Data (PLFS 2023–24)
